fusions.name: Point at the Door
fusions.desc: Throws you point-first at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage ignoring armour, up to 2 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Skewered Row
fusions.desc: Throws a thin shaft that deals 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Couched Stance
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Aimed Spring
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
